four_independent_findings_and_five_owner.prior_phrase: Sections1031–1035 print replacements extending specified Guantanamo detention, transfer or facility restrictions, including1031's2027→2032 operand and annual2025→2026 replacements.
four_independent_findings_and_five_owner.current_phrase: Section1031 extends the FY2004 NDAA1022(b) availability of joint-task-force drug-interdiction/counterdrug funds for qualifying counterterrorism or counter-transnational-organized-crime support by changing its endpoint from fiscal2027 to fiscal2032. The dated1022 authority concerns a DoD joint task force already supporting law-enforcement counterdrug activities, remains subject to applicable laws and regulations, and requires the Secretary of Defense to find a significant relationship to counterdrug-support objectives unless the Secretary waives that condition as vital to United States national security interests with prompt written congressional notice. Its annual reporting and retained certification conditions remain; this is not a Guantanamo restriction or a new unrestricted immigration-enforcement power. Separately, sections1032–1035 extend the specified Guantanamo transfer/release, US-facility construction/modification and closure/control funding restrictions through the printed2026 date or fiscal-year endpoints.

four_independent_findings_and_five_owner.prior_phrase: The existing relevant lawful-status, prior same-employer service, disciplinary/security/background/country, steward-department, no-watch/navigation and credential conditions remain.
four_independent_findings_and_five_owner.current_phrase: For the8103(k)(1)(C) category, the retained8103(k)(3)(A)(i) condition requires employment for at least one year on a passenger vessel under the same common ownership OR control as the specified vessel, as certified to the Secretary by that vessel’s owner or managing operator; it does not require the same employer. The relevant lawful-status, written disciplinary verification, government security check, employer-background-check/report/country, steward-department, no-watch/navigation and credential conditions remain, with the separate(C)/(D) documentation/employment branches preserved.

four_independent_findings_and_five_owner.current_phrase: Section7321 adds specified waterfront cyber/transnational-crime/foreign-state protection purposes and adds to70011(b)’s actions authorized the prohibition of visits by a REPRESENTATIVE OF A GOVERNMENT of a country determined under22US2371 to have repeatedly supported international terrorism, at a facility for which a70103(c) security plan is required.
